subject: rt-op
title: RT.OP.------POL.DY.
description: Diagram in NYM-12, on the page where Braxton argues that 'by separating the music from the black community, the net effect of this control would find black musicians having to rely on the whims of the western defining and controlling community for survival.' RT-OP (reality options) is crossed with POL-DYM (political dynamics). Besides the main line to POL-DYM (the crossing), two lines leave the subject. SPT-GH (spiritual growth) → POST (postulation) → TRS (transition) → SF-RZ (self-realization). TR-DEF (trans-definition) → ALT-F (alternative functionalism) → UNF-PI (unification (positively intended)), and TR-DEF → VT-ATT (vibrational attitude) → PART (participation).
